Adventures in Costco -commuting commenced!!

I began by researching a [@costco](/costco/) membership… As a one person household I’ve held off on this all these years, but as I compared the prices i pay on my regular weekly grocery trips and ran the numbers, the conclusion was compelling: assuming I didn’t over-shop and let food go to waste by buying in bulk, the Costco option would save me loads of money on food and household essentials. \*Even with the membership fee. Plus it’s a longer commute! 🙌🏼

Knowing there would be ample chances to buy stuff i normally wouldn’t and to over-shop, I grabbed a box and skipped a cart. I focused on the fresh items /essentials that the dogs and I can honestly polish off. (They LOVE carrots 🥕 and broccoli 🥦 !) and my bill ended up at $76. The box also fit perfectly in my [@burleydesign](/burleydesign/) tail wagon. ✅

As as I was packing the bike to leave, fellow bike-commuter and shopper Dante was loading his backpack and navigating one extra item he had to carry by hand (snoopsicles- popsicles by Snoop!).
We chatted about our setups and I asked if I could take a 🤳- we had big smiles as we parted.
Bikes= connection!!! ❤️
I guarantee you, people looking for parking spots for their cars in the lot aren’t chatting and feeling good vibes like Dante and I were!

I also went to staples for printer cartridges, and did a drop off at goodwill today too.
= Successful set of errands- all using the bike.
AND, thanks to [@goodsuniteus](/goodsuniteus/) I can feel good about the places I patronize.

A nod to [@deemontie](/deemontie/) for the inspo to join and bike to Costco! 😊 & I know this would be [@mrmoneymustache](/mrmoneymustache/) approved!

A reminder: if I can do this, you can too!
